name: Gethsemane
overview: Gethsemane is the garden near Jerusalem where Jesus experienced profound sorrow and anguish as He prepared to fulfill the Father's will. In this place, He invited His disciples to watch and pray with Him, expressing the deep heaviness of His soul and the struggle between His human desire to avoid suffering and His submission to God's plan. Despite His earnest prayers, Jesus demonstrated perfect obedience, teaching the necessity of vigilance in prayer to resist temptation, as His disciples struggled to stay awake and support Him in this critical hour.
